notes.title: Round 2: Live and Kicking!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504486/469f8378320e30e329ac0b49531406f0eb1c7121.jpg[/img]
The second playtest is rolling — and it’s getting bloody.
We’re pushing live fixes on the fly. No mercy for bugs.
[b]Here’s what’s already patched:[/b]
[list]
[*] Sounds added
[*] Character display fixed in the menu
[*] Killer's nickname now shows correctly
[*] Bot kills are now counted
[*] HUD issues fixed
[/list]
[b]Here’s the drill:[/b]
[list]
[*] Play.
[*] Break stuff.
[*] Report it.
[*] Repeat.
[*] 
[/list]
Voice chat’s live. Deathmatch and TDM are heating up.
If something’s wrong — yell about it here. We’re watching.

Get in. Test hard. Help us build a monster.

tags.bug: [*] Character display fixed in the menu

notes.title: DevBlog 15/04 – The New Android Model
notes.content:
Greetings, gladiators!
Welcome to our DevBlog series, where we’ll regularly share behind-the-scenes updates, upcoming features, visual upgrades, and more. 
These entries are designed to keep you — our players and testers — in sync with our development journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504486/33cb9cb0272aa10e45af577b5a8c4da8d756d081.jpg[/img]

[b]The Android Has Evolved[/b]
We’ve completed a major update to the core android model. It is now:
[list]
[*] Stronger — with a reinforced frame and improved animations
[*] More complete — visually and technically
[*] More impactful — both in presence and gameplay
[/list]
This is more than a cosmetic update — it’s the foundation for a deeper, more immersive player experience.

[b]Customization System in Development[/b]
We are actively working on a player customization system that will allow you to personalize your android. From visual elements to functional modules, you’ll be able to shape your android to match your unique style and strategy.
Stay tuned — more details will be revealed soon.

[b]Special Skin for Top Playtesters[/b]
We’re also preparing a limited-edition reward skin that will be granted only to the top-performing players in the upcoming playtest.
Your skill, strategy, and contribution to testing will determine who earns it.

Thanks for being a part of this journey.
We’ll see you in the next DevBlog — and on the battlefield.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2259240/DESPA/ style=button][b]Wishlist now and join the playtest![/b][/url]
